name: Construction incidents
description: Accidents, incidents and notifications DOB records at construction sites, 2024 on, with injury and fatality counts.

name: Structural complaints
description: DOB complaints in the structural categories: adjacent building not protected (03), excavation undermining (14), inadequate shoring (16), structural stability (30), retaining wall (54), structurally compromised (2K), new building stability (5C).

name: Vacate orders
description: HPD orders to vacate, with the primary reason (fire damage, habitability, illegal occupancy).

name: Unsafe facades
description: Facade inspection filings marked UNSAFE or SWARMP (safe with a repair and maintenance program).
source_name: DOB NOW: Safety - Facades Compliance Filings

name: Sandy inundation zone
description: The area flooded by Hurricane Sandy in 2012.

name: E-designations
description: Lots with an environmental designation for hazardous materials, air or noise.

name: Excavation next to older attached buildings
description: Active earth-work, foundation or support-of-excavation filings on a lot that touches an attached building built before 1940.
source_name: DOB NOW: Build - Job Application Filings, PLUTO
